description: Chinese robot maker Unitree Robotics on Monday opened subscriptions for its initial public offering (IPO) on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's sci‑tech innovation board, or STAR Market, following a preliminary offline price inquiry that indicated strong investor demand.中国机器人企业宇树科技周一启动上海证券交易所科创板新股申购，此前开展的初步线下询价显示投资者认购需求旺盛。 The Hangzhou‑based company is offering 40.446434 million shares at 150.80 yuan (about $22) each, representing 10 percent of its post‑offering share capital.
